title: Enhanced Cycling Stability of ZnO-Doped NiCo2O4 Electrodes for Acidic Solid-State Symmetric Supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00707K, Paper
Lipika Sarkar, Sunanda Pal, Sutanu Das, Farhin Sultana, Arnab Banerjee, Bibhutibhushan Show, Upendranath Nandi
An eco-friendly and cost-effective reflux approach is employed to synthesize $ZnO$-doped $NiCo_2O_4$ ($NCOXZnO$) nanocomposites for supercapacitor applications. Advanced sophisticated tools are employed to investigate the structure, surface morphology, magnetic properties,...
